posts.headline: Thicks pushed Klint's Clipboard to 5-2 but 39 editions later the ring is still sitting in a drawer collecting dust next to a measly 839.22 points-for.
posts.detail: A title from two seasons ago doesn't excuse career averages of a 5.5 finish — this is pedigree running on fumes while the receipts stay unpaid.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is now 2-5, and a 20-8 career record with the league's best 1.5 average finish has officially become a museum exhibit of former glory.
posts.detail: This is the same GM who boasts 714 career win percentage and now can't climb out of the Titty Committee basement — fraud trial pushing 40 chapters deep.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh can't build on that one win, stuck at 1-6 with a league-worst 714.02 points that matches his 12-average-finish destiny.
posts.detail: A career 4-10 record was supposed to be the floor — instead it's looking like the ceiling for this franchise's entire existence.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie keeps rolling at 6-1 with 941.98 points, and the African Bald Fraud slander is starting to look like defamation with zero supporting evidence.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops has a modest career 15-13 mark on paper, but this season's production is making the bit sound like jealousy, not journalism.
